title: DAIMM
tagline: The rapid advancement in Artificial Intelligence (AI) has led to the creation of diverse AI models that serve various purposes across multiple industries. However, accessing, sharing, and monetizing these models remain centralized.
description: The rapid advancement in Artificial Intelligence (AI) has led to the creation of diverse AI models that serve various purposes across multiple industries. However, accessing, sharing, and monetizing these models remain centralized. This project is intended to create a marketplace for showcasing AI Models and possibly create models too
how_its_made: This project has a smart contract with ERc721 to represent every AI model in the marketplace. The contract was deployed and AI model metadata was stored in IPFS. The frontend was designed with scaffoldeth2 template. We has in mind to integrate Filecoin, Lit Protocol and Galadriel.
